{"content": "import timeit

def run_benchmark():
    # Measure execution time of summing numbers from 1 to 10,000,000 using Python's built-in range and sum
    stmt = "sum(range(1, 10000001))"
    number_of_runs = 5
    total_time = timeit.timeit(stmt, number=number_of_runs)
    avg_time = total_time / number_of_runs
    print(f"Total time for {number_of_runs} runs: {total_time:.6f} seconds")
    print(f"Average execution time: {avg_time:.6f} seconds")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_benchmark()
